text: いしころ　あてると　にげる　かも　しれないが　つかまえ　やすくは　なるよ！

structure.jp: いしころ　あてると
structure.en: if you hit it with a Rock

structure.jp: にげる　かも　しれないが
つかまえ　やすくは　なるよ！
structure.en: it does become easier to catch!

patterns.name: 〜やすい
patterns.span: つかまえ　やすくは　なる
patterns.explanation: やすい on a verb stem means 'easy to do', and やすくなる means 'become easy to do'. The は in the middle adds 'at least that much is true'. つかまえ やすくは なる = 'it does become easier to catch'.

patterns.name: 〜と (if)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'if' or 'when' you do this, the next thing follows. あてると = 'if you hit it'.

patterns.name: 〜かもしれない
patterns.span: にげる　かも　しれない
patterns.explanation: かもしれない after a verb says it may happen but you are not sure. にげる かも しれない = 'it might run away'.
